items: Amazon, Urban League threaten NYC delivery bill suit. In a letter to Council Speaker Julie Menin, the National Urban League and an Amazon-led business coalition said they could sue if the Delivery Protection Act (Intro 518) passes in its current form. Their attorney wrote that the bill conflicts with federal and state law.

UniUni to hand peak packages to Gofo. UniUni said it will hand off select packages to other carriers, such as Gofo, for some peak season deliveries, per Supply Chain Dive on Nov. 16. The company said the move supports last-mile efficiency as it works to improve its financial outlook; no rate changes or effective dates were given.

USPS posts proposed January 2027 price files. The Price Change Center for the Jan. 17, 2027 change now lists proposed price files, SKU price files and a change log, all revised Nov. 12. The page states no price amounts, and the postage statement redlines now carry a "Proposed" status.
